assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation corresponds to diagnosis code I48.0.
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks.
Transient ischemic attacks correspond to diagnosis code G45.9.
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered.
The long-term continuous ECG monitoring service is represented by CPT code 93247.
The monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis codes I48.0, G45.9, and Z86.73.
